entities.summary: Shunga, a notable figure in the history of India, associated with Post-Mauryan and Classical Period (185 BCE–300). Preceded by Shunga, Satavahana, and Kushan Kingdoms and Kushan Empire. Their legacy influenced Gupta Empire and Kalidasa writes Shakuntala and Meghaduta, masterpieces of Sanskrit literature.
